description: Enhanced JSON Error Responses for Vaccination Controller
improvements_made: Added detailed error messages with context
Added duplicate validation with helpful examples

enhanced_error_response.error: Duplicate vaccination numbers detected in the request.
enhanced_error_response.message: Each vaccination must have a unique vaccination number.
enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please use different vaccination numbers for each vaccination code.

enhanced_error_response.message: The specified child does not exist in the system.
enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please verify the child ID and ensure the child is registered in the system.

enhanced_error_response.error: Parent or phone number not found
enhanced_error_response.message: Unable to send SMS verification because parent information or phone number is missing.
enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please ensure the child has a valid phone number and is linked to a parent user account.

enhanced_error_response.message: Unable to send verification code to the parent via SMS.
enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please check the phone number format and SMS service configuration.
troubleshooting: Verify phone number is in correct international format
Check SMS service credentials and configuration

enhanced_error_response.error: Verification failed for vaccination code: BCG
enhanced_error_response.message: No pending verification found, verification code expired, or invalid verification code.

possible_reasons: Verification code has expired (10 minutes limit)
No verification request was made for this vaccination code

enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please request a new verification code by calling store-with-verification endpoint first.

enhanced_error_response.error: No available vaccination record found for: BCG
enhanced_error_response.message: No vaccination record available for processing.

required_conditions: vaccination_code must exist in vaccinations table
vaccine must be in waiting status (Hali = inasubiri)
vaccination_no must be NULL (not yet assigned)

enhanced_error_response.suggestion: Please ensure vaccination records are properly seeded in the database with correct status.

enhanced_error_response.message: The number of vaccination codes must match the number of vaccination numbers.

step_1.description: Test your original JSON with duplicate vaccination numbers
step_1.expected_result: Will now return detailed error about duplicate vaccination numbers

step_2.expected_result: Should work correctly and send SMS verification

benefits_of_enhanced_errors: Developers get clear information about what went wrong
Specific suggestions for fixing the issue
Structured data for programmatic error handling
Reduced support requests due to clearer error messages
